title: Development foundation: reproducible green baseline
objective: A clean checkout of the repository passes the full validation gate locally and on Windows, macOS, and Linux CI, builds valid distribution artifacts, and has deterministic line endings and a committed dependency lock.
business_value: Every later work package depends on a reproducible, verifiable baseline; without it, worker validation evidence is not trustworthy.
scope: Commit the lint, format, and typing fixes that make the scaffold pass the validation gate
Add .gitattributes enforcing LF for text files so checkout matches ruff line-ending=lf on all platforms
Commit uv.lock and switch CI to uv sync --locked for reproducible resolution

Add wheel and sdist build to CI (uv build) and verify the built wheel contains the packaged context template, including files hatchling might drop through VCS-ignore handling (context_template/.gitignore, 98_state/.gitkeep)
Add [project.urls] and PEP 639 license metadata to pyproject.toml
Add pre-commit to the dev dependency group and document it in CONTRIBUTING.md, or remove .pre-commit-config.yaml; pick one and record it
Add a CI concurrency group to cancel superseded runs
Verify the src/workctx/domain/__init__.py package marker (created by the lead during WP-000) is committed with the baseline
Align docs/concepts.md observation-kind wording ('task signal') with the observation.schema.json enum value ('task')
non_goals: No new product features or CLI commands
No changes to plan documents or product invariants
No PyPI publishing or release automation
No testing of the mcp optional extra (deferred to WP-330)
No coverage threshold enforcement (recorded as a later decision)
deliverables: Green validation gate from a clean checkout
CI build step producing wheel and sdist, with verified template content
acceptance_criteria: uv run ruff check ., uv run ruff format --check ., uv run mypy src, and uv run pytest all pass from a clean checkout
A fresh git checkout on Windows produces LF working-tree files for tracked text (verified via git ls-files --eol)
uv build produces a wheel and sdist; the wheel contains src/workctx/resources/context_template with the same file set tracked in git, including .gitignore and 98_state/.gitkeep
GitHub Actions CI matrix passes on ubuntu, windows, and macos for Python 3.12 and 3.13 once the repository is pushed
security_constraints: Do not introduce secrets, private data, or network-dependent tests
Do not add install steps that execute remote scripts outside documented package-manager behavior
stop_conditions: Any required change to product invariants or plan documents
CI requires repository settings or credentials only the human operator can provide
